system.description:
1st Level Clan Feature

Your clans Kekkei Genkai grants you unparallel control over the physical makeup of metals you infuse your chakra into, even able to liquify them to make it easier to reshape. Your clan has fostered a plethora of ways to utilize this Alomancy, which are represented as Liquid Metal Ingots, of which, you have an amount equal to 1 + your proficiency bonus.

You can spend these Ingots to fuel your Alomancy. You begin with 1 Alomancy Technique of your choice. You gain an additional Alomancy Technique at 7th and 15th levels. If an Alomancy forces a saving throw, or requires an attack use your highest jutsu attack or saving throw to resolve its effect. You regain spent ingots when you complete a short rest.

Iron Bulwark

As a Reaction, to an allied creature within 30 feet of you taking damage you can spend 1 Ingot to project a metallic shield, intercepting damage, acting as a barrier for them. The barrier projected has hit points equal to 2d6 + 6 and DR equal to your highest ability modifier. Its hit points increase by +1d6 at 7th, and 15th levels. This barrier lasts until the beginning of your next turn.

| #### Art Link / Pinterest Link |

Steel Reinforcement

As a Bonus action, you can select one willing creature within 30 feet of you wearing armor or wielding a weapon, and wrap them in your metallic chakra, spending 2 Ingots. When you do, for the next minute their armor or weapons bulk is increased by either +2, +4 or +6, your choice. The chosen bulk increase also provides some benefits for the duration.

Bulk +2. The target gains the Fortified property and a +2 bonus to their Armor Bonus.

Bulk +4. Same as Bulk +2 & a +2 bonus to their Constitution Saving throws.

Bulk +6. Same as Bulk +2 and a +2 bonus to their Strength and Constitution Saving throws.

Metallic Thorns

As a Bonus action, by spending 1 ingot, you can select a point you can see within 30 feet of you, and fill a 10-foot cube with liquid metal that form into spike when a creature of your choice steps onto the space, forcing them to make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d6 piercing damage, gaining 2 ranks of Bleed and reducing their remaining movement by 15 on a failure, or half damage on a successful save. This trapped area lasts for 1 minute and can trigger once per turn.

This damage increases by 1d6 at 7th and 15th levels and the ranks of Bleed increases by +1 at 11th level.

Metallic Step

As a reaction, to seeing an allied creature other than yourself, within 60 feet of you be forced to make a Strength, Dexterity or Constitution saving throw, by spending 1 ingot, you can form some of the metal on their person, into something that can pull them, dragging them up to 20-feet into a space closer to you, in a straight line without triggering opportunity attacks. If this movement would pull them out of the triggering effects range, they make their saving throw at advantage, otherwise, they gain a +2 bonus to their saving throw.

Superheavy Metals

As part of dealing damage with a metallic weapon or Konjiki Hijutsu, you can spend up to four Ingots to magnify its weight, making it barrel through any defense. When you do, if the affected creature is Bruised, they suffer the effect of Bruised once additional time for each ingot spent.

Supersharp

As part of dealing damage with a metallic weapon or Konjiki Hijutsu, you can spend up to two Ingots to magnify the piercing capabilities of the strike, gaining 4 Pierce for every ingot spent this way.

Metallic Fan

As part of dealing damage with a metallic weapon or Konjiki Hijutsu that targets a single creature, you can spend one Ingot to magnify the striking range of the attack. All creatures within 5-Feet of the original target must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking the attacks original damage on a failure or no damage on a success. If this attack is a critical hit, all creatures making their saving throw make their save at disadvantage.
